nodes.label: Project memory
nodes.content: Project memory records Herdr socket-protocol verification precautions, Pi ownership boundaries, and the locations of runtime state and graphify output.

edges.evidence: Memory warns that an old Herdr server can cause protocol_mismatch and recommends fresh socket and XDG paths.
Memory places Pi-owned implementation under packages/pi and keeps environment selection, Herdr, project state, and graphify output at their broader ownership locations.
